title: Dropping Anchor: A Field Experiment Assessing a Salary History Ban with Archival Replication
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment (230 hires, UK) plus an interrupted time series of one recruitment firm that adopted a salary history ban on a single date in 2018. No unit-level staggered adoption; no panel TWFE with multiple adoption cohorts.
design_notes: Study 1 is an ITT regression on randomized assignment with salary-band and covariate controls. Study 2 compares placements before/after one firm-level adoption date (3,687 placements, Nov 2009-Jun 2019); gender inferred from first names. The 'difference-in-differences' mention in the text refers to pre-experiment baseline hires and the female x SHB interaction, not staggered adoption. Prior literature cited (Sinha 2019; Bessen et al. 2021) uses state-staggered DiD but this paper does not.
screener_notes: Ineligible: randomization plus single-date ITS. Data from a private UK educational institution and a recruitment firm; no replication package listed in batch.
